Ux. is the Latin word for wife.
Ux. means the same as uxor.
uxor: Uxor is the Latin word for wife.
Uxor means the same as ux..
uxoricide: An uxoricide is a husband who murders his wife.
Uxoricide can also mean the murder of a wife by her husband.
uxoriousness: Uxoriousness is foolish fondness for or excessive submissiveness to one's wife.
uxorial: Uxorial means befitting or characteristic of a wife.
Uxorial means the same as wifely or wifelike.
uxorious: Uxorious means foolishly fond of or submissive to your wife.
uxoriously: Uxoriously means in a loving and uxorious manner.
For example: "He kept deferring uxoriously to Mary."
